game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing, a rope bridge over a pit: the spelunker must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the rope bridge fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Lantern Crossing: a rope bridge over a pit
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 2: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Characteristics and limits.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: The rival reaches the rope bridge first, or lives reach 0.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
